verdict.rationale: React's repository states the story almost verbatim: "Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them to make complex UIs" [react-gh-1]. The docs reinforce it: apps are made of components with their own logic and appearance [react-docs-11], components receive data and update the screen in response to interactions [react-docs-3, react-docs-24], and DevTools can inspect and edit component state [react-docs-14]. missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of the local-state mechanism itself (e.g., state hook docs), independent or hands-on corroboration of component encapsulation and composition.
